relationships.subject: GluN2D-containing NMDA receptors
relationships.evidence_quote: Animals with conditional deletion of GluN2D receptors from parvalbumin interneurons (PVIs) or local ablation of GluN2D from nucleus accumbens (NAc) displayed reduced mechanical hypersensitivity in CINP

relationships.subject: parvalbumin interneurons
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings suggest that inhibition of PVIs in the NAc alleviates CINP-like mechanical hypersensitivity.

relationships.subject: GluN2C-containing NMDA receptors
relationships.evidence_quote: GluN2C KO showed no significant difference in response to mechanical stimuli in CINP compared to wildtype

key_findings: GluN2D NMDARs in nucleus accumbens PV interneurons regulate cisplatin neuropathic pain but not inflammatory or acute pain.
Chemogenetic inhibition of NAc PVIs relieves, activation induces, mechanical hypersensitivity.
